name: Aggressive Striker with Goal-First Mindset
description: A lone blue agent positions to receive through-balls and finish chances quickly, prioritizing direct shots on goal over elaborate buildup.

name: Smart Playmaker and Ball Conveyor
description: Focuses on creating non-obvious passing lanes, drawing defenders, and driving the team toward the goal with well-timed runs and decisive passes.

name: Defensive Anchor and Space Controller
description: Stays central to protect the blue goal, intercepts threats, maintains compact shape, and seizes counter-attack opportunities when ball is won.

name: Wing Runner and Cross Specialist
description: Drifts along the sideline to stretch the defense, looks for crosses or cutting inside opportunities to create scoring chances.
